claims.title: Fresh cohort guards certify a reusable finite-field family before old sources expire

quoted_fields.interface: Declared paid fitter, finite polynomial language and independent known-program rank tests, actual uniform native sampling and fresh independent guards. Each source is fixed throughout acquisition and survives through fitting/validation. Future source near-family distance is a separate coverage condition; the soundness guard does not assume it.
quoted_fields.failure: The earlier strict r+1-value expiry contract does not supply these guards. Aggregate soundness and tolerant power are joint events, not automatic conditional-on-return guarantees. A one-point corruption can destroy raw anchor fitting despite tiny average error; native correction is essential. No unseen global rank exhaustion, arbitrary future task coverage, real-coefficient L2 extension or unbounded concentrated interactive reuse. Concentration/self-correction have established stronger conventional counterparts.

claims.title: Task effects renew quantum faults, with an explicit exchange-preserving boundary and its counterexample

quoted_fields.interface: A genuinely closed bounded coherent port during each declared call, trusted full weak instruments and outer framing, private current controls, isolated past/future logical wires and references, upstream mixed preparation for general effect tomography. The exchange alternative supplies a different conditional boundary: actual exchange, bounded single-site nuisance strength/interaction-picture Lipschitz constant, synchronized finite pulse profiles and actual receiver extraction at output.
quoted_fields.failure: A small port is an architectural premise/construction, not inferred from finite good tests. General qubit effects need16 coefficients per setting; multi-qubit port width is exponential. Exact centrality concerns each effect and a fixed/exogenous schedule, not fine-record-dependent fixed iid laws. Bad-weight envelopes do not automatically transfer through future postselection or untrusted coherent framing. Bath-modulated exchange lies in the control commutant and is not suppressed. Current transfer is distinct from protected repeated outputs, and native model operations are not hardware.
